headline: Address cooking oil and plain flour cost increases urgently.

actions.title: Cooking Oil Price Increase
actions.advice: Request the old price of $3.70/L from HARBOURLINE DRY GOODS PTE LTD.

actions.title: Plain Flour Hidden Increase
actions.advice: Ask HARBOURLINE DRY GOODS PTE LTD to revert to the 10kg pack at $16.00.

actions.title: Butter Price Increase
actions.advice: Consider buying unsalted butter in bulk to reduce costs.

actions.title: Milk Price Increase
actions.advice: Adjust the menu price of milk-based items to cover the extra cost.

actions.title: Rice Price Increase
actions.advice: Buy jasmine rice in larger quantities to reduce per kg cost.

actions.title: Onions Price Increase
actions.advice: Request a quote from another supplier for brown onions.

actions.title: Cheaper Eggs
actions.advice: Switch to Northgate Dairy & Meats for eggs to save $250/year.

email.subject: Request for Price Reversion
email.body:
Dear HARBOURLINE DRY GOODS PTE LTD,

I noticed recent price increases for cooking oil and plain flour. Could you please revert to the previous prices of $3.70/L for cooking oil and the 10kg pack of plain flour at $16.00? These changes significantly impact our budget.

Thank you for your understanding and support.

Best regards,
[Your name], [Your business]
